blueprint.title: VR Half Paper — First Sitting

sections.instructions: This is a half-length paper — a real run at real pace, just shorter. Read each question. Five answers are shown; pick one and mark it clearly. If a question feels hard, move on and come back.
Same rules as the first section. Letters and numbers now. Work steadily — about a minute a question — and mark one answer for each.
